title: His present band: size and workload
summary: The current band ranges from seven to nine players depending on the job, with seven as the regular number.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: We would be playing more than no catchmen if there were more jobs. Ha ha ha.
How many of your groups now? Still seven? Ha ha ha. Yes.
Some times, but it ranges from seven to eight or nine. I mean, it depends. What the, I mean, the people that we work with, it depends on the number that they want to.
But the regular pen was only seven.
